metrics_plotted.name: cos(τ·AB, -G)
metrics_plotted.description: Cosine similarity between analog tile product τ·AB and negative gradient -G. Scale-invariant (same as cos(AB,-G)). Positive values indicate alignment with descent direction.

metrics_plotted.name: cos(ΔC, τ·AB)
metrics_plotted.description: Cosine similarity between actual C tile update ΔC and intended transfer τ·AB. Measures fidelity of analog transfer under quantization.
